tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Existence of Closed Geodesics] 1. ch6:6.28Let $(M,g)$ be compact and connected. Every nontrivial free homotopy class is represented by a closed geodesic of minimum length among all admissible loops in that class.

Every compact Riemannian manifold admits a closed geodesic; see \cite{Jos17} and \cite{Kli95}.
